# Chase Global Variable Over Time

Source: [wiki article 4334](../archive/4334.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Chase Global Variable Over Time](../../api/actions/chase-global-variable-over-time.md).

<a id="wiki-4334-n1"></a>

- Before chasing, initialize the variable to the same number/vector type as its destination; Duration is seconds, and selected inputs may reevaluate continuously.
